items.title: David Spinozza interviewed by Monk Rowe, New Hartford, NY, September 27, 2025
items.q: INTERVIEWER: My name is Monk Rowe and I’m very pleased to have David Spinozza with me this morning...

ctx.x: Dave was interviewed via Zoom on September 27, 2025 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
My name is Monk Rowe and I’m very pleased to have David Spinozza with me this morning in, let’s see, we’re in New Hartford, New York after a gig. Thanks for coming.
